controlled_vocabulary: all_vertebrates | vertebrates_plus_designated_invertebrates_by_regulation | vertebrates_plus_cephalopods_policy_only | domestic_and_captive_only_with_named_exclusions | protected_wildlife_species_only | captive_bred_wildlife_only | livestock_and_disease_vectors_only | companion_and_livestock_broad | vertebrates_excluding_fish | all_animals_undifferentiated | single_species_targeted | mammals_birds_reptiles_in_human_possession
description: Closed vocabulary - do not free-text this field. Add a new controlled value (with a one-line justification in the codebook) rather than approximating with an existing one. Three values added 2026-09-15: vertebrates_excluding_fish (US PACT Act - mammal/bird/reptile/amphibian only, fish explicitly absent); all_animals_undifferentiated (Canada Criminal Code - 'animal or bird', no taxonomic or domestic-status qualifier at all); single_species_targeted (South Korea's dog-meat phase-out act - targets one named species, not animals-in-general). Fourth value added same session (Japan): mammals_birds_reptiles_in_human_possession - Japan's 'aigo doubutsu' definition explicitly excludes BOTH fish AND amphibians (narrower than vertebrates_excluding_fish) AND requires the animal be 'in human possession' (excludes feral/wild populations of the same species) - a combination of taxonomic-class and possession-status limits not captured by any existing value.
